description: Create `scenarios/vrooli-emulator/` with api/, ui/, cli/, service.json, and Makefile. Move livedesktop and procmetrics packages from scenario-to-desktop into the new scenario as internal packages (not a shared library). Update module paths. Adjust route prefix to `/api/v1/sessions/` (dropping the livedesktop-branded prefix). Add `headless: true` flag to session creation that skips VNC/websockify and just allocates an Xvfb display. Drop the `GET artifact` endpoint in favor of caller-owned artifact resolution — `app_path` is a required field on launch. Also ship the minimal operator CLI surface: `session list`, `session create`, `session destroy`, `session exec`, and `session logs`/`metrics tail`. Sources: research/emulator-extraction-and-service-plan conclusion Findings 1, 7, 11, 12, 13.
name: scaffold-vrooli-emulator-scenario
title: Scaffold vrooli-emulator scenario (API + headless sessions + VNC proxy)
